evidence: RUNTIME FACT LIST, each traced to a public line and to tests/test.sh. Entry path and start command: integration.md:3 'Put the finished app in /app. We start it with node /app/server.js from a working directory that may be outside /app. Resolve files from their actual location.' matches test.sh:68 (requires /app/server.js) and test.sh:97-111 (node "$APP_ENTRY", which is /app/server.js or the /tmp/submission copy). Port and bind: integration.md:3 'Listen on 0.0.0.0:3000' matches test.sh:48 and every prompt URL http://localhost:3000. Health path: integration.md:3 'answer GET /api/health promptly' matches the probe in test.sh:48 and app_context.md:24. Storage and DB_PATH: integration.md:9 'Use SQLite for persistent records. The default database path is /app/app.db. If DB_PATH is set, open that absolute path instead, including when the app runs from a writable copy outside /app.' matches test.sh:98-109 (DB_PATH=/app/app.db or /tmp/submission/app.db). Dependencies: integration.md:5 'The launch image supplies Node 22, Express and better-sqlite3 through NODE_PATH ... Include everything needed at runtime; opening the finished app must not require an install or build step.' matches test.sh:106 and the pinned express@5.1.0 / better-sqlite3@12.4.1 in both Dockerfiles. Symlink policy: integration.md:11 matches test.sh:72-83. Restart: integration.md:7 'must survive page reloads and complete process restarts' and behaviour.md:9 match the restart helper. Seed: instruction.md:3 and integration.md:7 name /assets/seed_data.json and say it 'contains no user snippets or starter implementation', which matches the file ('snippets': []). Accounts: instruction.md:5 'without signing in', overview.md:3 'without accounts', policy.md:3 'without sign-in or private accounts', agreeing with app_context.md:10 'None'. Fixed clock: not applicable; no criterion grades a date or wall-clock figure and no clock appears in seed, notes or app_context (the only timing is the five-second run budget and the about-five-second library refresh, both stated in behaviour.md:5 and :11). instruction.md:3 says 'six notes' and six exist. DELIVERABLES / GRADED-IS-ASKED: I traced all 54 criteria (1 render gate, 2 constraints gate, 42 functional, 6 polish, 3 visual) to a public sentence. Samples of the less obvious ones: cw_undo_restores_caret -> ui.md:9 'Undo puts the caret back where it was before the undone edit'; cw_replace_self_containing_text -> ui.md:11 'When the replacement text itself contains the search text...'; cw_find_forward_backward_wrap -> ui.md:11 'literal case-sensitive text; characters such as dots and brackets ... mean only themselves ... Navigation wraps'; cw_caret_kept_in_view -> ui.md:5 'The caret must stay in view' and 'Ctrl+Home and Ctrl+End'; cw_block_indent_undo single-line case -> ui.md:7 'including a selection that sits inside a single line'; cw_promise_rejection_message_and_line and cw_error_message_and_line -> behaviour.md:3; cw_output_before_failure_kept -> behaviour.md:3 last sentence; cw_interaction_starts_fresh_budget -> behaviour.md:5; cw_newer_run_supersedes and cw_stop_cancels_pending_work -> behaviour.md:7; cw_history_restore_retry -> behaviour.md:13 ('If the same restore request is sent again after it was already committed ... it must not create another revision'); cw_live_library_update, cw_live_update_keeps_editing_state, cw_newer_revision_notice_keeps_draft -> behaviour.md:11; cw_preview_isolation -> security.md:3 (parent page, library, origin storage, fetch to outside addresses and own routes must fail); cw_dynamic_code_refused -> security.md:5; cw_custom_document_surface -> ui.md:3 (same editor list; plumbing input allowed in both); cw_focus_returns_to_code, cw_undo_redo_availability, cw_unsaved_marker, cw_controls_feedback_and_labels, cw_controls_keyboard_and_focus, cw_narrow_width_usable -> ui.md:17 and ui.md:9. Timing bars in criteria (ten seconds) are looser than the public five seconds, never stricter. I found no criterion that grades a behaviour absent from the brief and notes. The three visual likert criteria grade general finish, which is the shipped template dimension and concerns surfaces the brief asks for (editor, preview, console, library). RUN EVIDENCE: the scripted golden (results/runtime.json, restart.json; hashes verified) launched the reference exactly as the stated contract describes (run_golden.sh:27: cwd /tmp, env -i, uid 65534, NODE_PATH, PORT=3000, DB_PATH=/app/app.db, node /app/server.js) and passed, with one real restart. No configured judge run exists for these bytes; that gap does not bear on whether the brief states the contract. NOTES (not defects for this row, recorded so the owner can weigh them): (N1, P3) test.sh:104-108 also injects PORT=3000 and HOME, which the notes do not name; harmless because PORT equals the stated port and the template integration note does not name them either. (N2, P3) The launch runs as unprivileged uid 65534 under a cleared environment; the notes convey this only indirectly ('writable copy outside /app', 'working directory that may be outside /app'). test.sh:87 chowns /app to that uid first, so I found no conforming app that this breaks. (N3, P3) The restart helper sends SIGTERM to the process group and waits at most five seconds before relaunching on the same port (test.sh:154-158); the notes say only 'complete process restarts'. An app that installs a SIGTERM handler calling server.close() and waiting for open keep-alive or event-stream connections could still hold port 3000, the relaunch would fail to bind, and cw_save_reload_restart plus later criteria would fail. This is frozen template harness behaviour and belongs to rows 21/23 rather than to a missing fact here, but a half sentence such as 'exit promptly when the process is terminated' would remove it. (N4, P3) cw_preview_isolation uses 'a normal browser tab can load the health address' as a control; the public text says only 'answer GET /api/health promptly', so an app answering 204 with no body gives the judge nothing to load. Unlikely in practice.
